summary.text: Patti Anderson is a Republican who represents District 33A in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2022.

Her official House page lists committee assignments including Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy, Taxes, and Transportation Finance and Policy, and gives her occupation as business owner, with a B.A. from the University of Minnesota and an M.A. in public administration from Hamline University.

sources.title: Rep. Patti Anderson (33A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
